---
title: "Palmer Penguin DaSHBoard"
author: "cody tengan"
format: dashboard
---

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(janitor)

penguins <- read.csv("penguins_lter.csv")
view(penguins)

penguins <- penguins %>%
  clean_names()


ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = culmen_depth_mm)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

```

```{r echo=FALSE}
mass_by_flipper <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species, shape = island)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
   labs(title = "Palmer Penguins, Flipper Length & Body Mass",
       x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       y = "Body Mass (g)")

ggplotly(mass_by_flipper)
```
